dedupe_keys.name: french mediterranean tsunami cell broadcast reactions and intended evacuation delays

description: This survey dataset records reactions to a Cell Broadcast tsunami-alert exercise along the French Mediterranean coast. Avignon University and collaborating researchers worked with prefectures and the Ministry of Interior during a test covering 189 municipalities in nine departments. The article and repository title identify 19 January 2024; one sentence in the repository description instead says 2022, an unresolved metadata discrepancy. The collection contains 9,446 complete responses to twenty-four questions, including intended delay before evacuation and reactions to the alert. Mendeley supplies French and English CSV versions with dictionaries and survey documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Self-selection and stated intentions during a test are limitations for predicting actual evacuation behaviour. Modellers could construct response-delay scenarios for pedestrian evacuation simulations using model-jupedsim. The two language files describe the same survey, not independent samples. No response rows were downloaded or observed evacuation rate inferred.
